patch.value:
## Context
Monica stable 4.x remains fully mapped, but authoritative main now exposes a separate Sanctum API for the authenticated user, account users, and vault CRUD. The CLI currently models only stable 4.x, so agents cannot reason about or invoke the latest available API edition.

## Delivery
- Preserve the stable 4.x catalog while adding an authoritative main-edition catalog and freshness verification.
- Add typed users and vaults command groups for every current main API route.
- Detect and document edition compatibility without misclassifying unavailable infrastructure.
- Keep default TOON, JSON/YAML/Markdown/table schemas, agent exports, setup/doctor guidance, and help contracts aligned.
- Upgrade repository PM tooling to the latest compatible published versions.

## Safety
Live acceptance is GET-only with readOnlyMode enabled. Mutations are covered by mocked integration tests and must be rejected before network access against the private instance. No credentials, user/vault identifiers, response payloads, or signed paths may enter Git, PM, logs, or GitHub.
Add Monica next-generation API editions and vault management
Expose the complete current Monica main-branch API alongside stable 4.x with typed users and vaults commands, edition-aware provenance, schemas, docs, agent contracts, and read-only-safe acceptance.

Every route currently declared by Monica main routes/api.php is represented by a typed CLI command and versioned reference entry; Stable 4.x compatibility remains complete and next-edition commands classify unsupported versus unavailable safely; All help, docs, output schemas, agent catalogs, setup/doctor guidance, and changelog state match runtime behavior; Exact 100/100/100/100 source coverage, 100 percent docstrings, under-300-LOC source files, zero duplication/security/privacy findings, packed npm/Bun proof, PM validation, and read-only live acceptance pass
Authoritative main has a concrete public API that differs from frozen stable 4.x, and latest-version compatibility now requires explicit edition modeling.
Monica stable 4.x and current main APIs; Bun 1.3.11; Node 22+; private live instance read-only
Compare authoritative main routes/api.php with monica info command-catalog and docs/monica-api-reference.json; users and vaults are absent.
Agents can inspect API editions and invoke every current stable or main endpoint through typed, schema-valid, documented commands.
The stable 4.x surface is complete, but current main user and vault routes and edition provenance are not represented.
Users and agents targeting current Monica development instances cannot discover or manage the available account and vault API through monica-cli.
